newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn sells 8.76 bln dmk Bubills at 98.445 and over.
newsitem.headline: Bonn sells 8.76 bln dmk Bubills at 98.445 and over.

text.p: The German government on Wednesday allocated 8.763 billion marks of six-month Treasury discount notes, or Bubills, at a lowest accepted price of 98.445 for an average yield of 3.10 percent, the Bundesbank as issuing agent said.
The weighted average issue price was 98.457, the Bundesbank said.
Bids totalled 12.6 billion marks of which price bids totalled 11.05 billion marks. The weighted average price bid was 98.444.
